allegro_right.method: calibrate_palm_up.py: 6 axis candidates x 5 curl fracs (full=False), repeats=8, held 2.0s @ 120 Hz zero-action holding a curled joint target (lower + curl_frac*(upper-lower) per joint), scored over the trailing 50% of steps as stability(dist to the fingertip-centroid spawn point < 0.08 m) x reach(>=2 fingertips within 0.05 m of the object)

dclaw.method: calibrate_palm_up.py: 6 axis candidates x 5 curl specs (full=False, profiles=True), repeats=8, held 2.0s @ 120 Hz zero-action holding a curled joint target (lower + frac*(upper-lower) per joint, frac either one uniform value or a per-position profile tiled cyclically over the joint order -- I25), scored over the trailing 50% of steps as stability(dist to the fingertip-centroid spawn point < 0.08 m) x reach(>=2 fingertips within 0.06 m of the object)

sharpa.method: calibrate_palm_up.py: 6 axis candidates x 5 curl fracs (full=False), repeats=16, held 3.0s @ 120 Hz zero-action holding a curled joint target (lower + curl_frac*(upper-lower) per joint), scored over the trailing 50% of steps as stability(dist to the fingertip-centroid spawn point < 0.08 m) x reach(>=2 fingertips within 0.05 m of the object)

tesollo_dg5f_right.method: calibrate_palm_up.py: 24 axis candidates x 2 curl specs (full=True, profiles=True), repeats=20, min_height_above_palm_m=0.02, held 2.0s @ 120 Hz zero-action holding a curled joint target (lower + frac*(upper-lower) per joint, frac either one uniform value or a per-position profile tiled cyclically over the joint order -- I25), scored over the trailing 50% of steps as stability(dist to the fingertip-centroid spawn point < 0.08 m) x reach(>=2 fingertips within 0.05 m of the object) x height(spawn point > 0.02 m above the palm's own world z -- I34, the same convention drop_detection.object_below_palm checks every reset)
